summary: Tested the NEW Charter Company billing/invoicing integration end-to-end: (1) Customer sync - verified via API and UI that creating/editing a Charter Company auto-creates/updates a linked db.users+db.customers record, visible in GET /api/store/customers with matching name/email/phone/billing address; 'Synced to Customers' badge renders both on cards (charter-company-synced-{id}) and in the edit Sheet (charter-company-sync-status) for seed 'Blue Dream Charters'. (2) New Charter Company billing fields (billing_address/city/state/zip, tax_id, invoice_email, payment_terms select with all 4 options) all present, editable, and persist after save+reload - verified via Playwright and pytest. (3) Admin Invoices page: Create Invoice flow with 2 line items verified live Subtotal/Tax/Total preview computed correctly ($125/$10/$135), saved invoice appeared in list with correct INV-XXXXXX-YY format and 'unpaid' status. (4) Invoice actions: Mark Paid (-> status=paid, due=$0), Void (-> status=void), Edit (Sheet reopens with line items + totals pre-filled correctly), Delete (row removed) all verified via Playwright with real DOM state checks. Charter Company row's invoice shortcut icon correctly deep-links to /admin/tours-charters/invoices?seller_id=X with company pre-filtered (verified 'filtered by charter company' subtitle + pre-selected seller on new invoice form). (5) Invoice Defaults settings: saved custom bank/venmo/check/note/sale-agent text, confirmed new Create Invoice form pre-filled with those exact defaults, then reset defaults back to blank as cleanup. (6) Public invoice view (/invoice/tours-charters/:invoiceId, no auth) renders full Google-Docs-style layout: Unpaid badge, Download+Pay Now buttons, Bill From (123Bots)/Bill To (seller name+billing address+tax id), line items table, Subtotal/Tax/Total/Amount Paid/Amount Due, custom note, transactions list, and Payment Options footer with Online 'Pay Now' + Offline bank text block. (7) Stripe Pay Now: clicking Pay Now on the real seed invoice successfully redirected the browser to a genuine https://checkout.stripe.com/... URL (test mode) for the correct amount; backend pay/status polling endpoint returns a valid payment_status without erroring (tested with real session_id via both Playwright and pytest). (8) FareHarbor API settings (Dev Settings > Feature Flags > Tours & Charters card at /dev/settings/features): entered plaintext values, saved, reloaded, and confirmed fields show masked bullet-prefixed values ending in the correct last-4-chars (••••7766 / ••••3344); confirmed the full-form PUT round-trip does NOT reset unrelated flags - activity_marketplace_enabled stayed Enabled, Coming Soon stayed OFF, other toggles unchanged (verified in both UI screenshot and pytest). (9) Accounting Dashboard: new 'Tours & Charters Income' card renders with Invoiced/Paid/Unpaid + invoice count, correctly reflects the $250 unpaid seed invoice; verified via pytest that a custom date range with no invoices in it returns zeroes (period-reactivity confirmed at the API level; the one real seed invoice is recent so 7-day vs 30-day UI comparison showed identical numbers as expected, not a bug). (10) Regression spot-checks: public /activities directory still renders correctly (Boat Charters tile), Charter Companies/Activities pages load fine. Backend: created new backend/tests/test_tours_charters_billing.py (26 tests, all passing) covering seller billing fields, customer sync, invoice CRUD/totals/status transitions, invoice settings, public invoice view, Stripe pay/status, accounting income endpoint, and FareHarbor flag masking + roundtrip. Also re-ran prior regression suites (test_tours_charters_marketplace.py, test_activity_seo_and_charter_companies.py, test_activity_card_fields.py = 43/43) - all still passing.

critical.issue: FOUND AND FIXED during this review: the @router.get("/dashboard/report") decorator had been dropped in accounting.py when the new GET /dashboard/tours-charters-income endpoint was inserted directly above it (no blank line/decorator separating the two function bodies), causing get_dashboard_report() to silently stop being a registered FastAPI route (returned 404 Not Found). This endpoint backs the accounting dashboard's 'Export CSV' button (AdminAccountingDashboard.jsx handleExportCSV -> GET {API}/dashboard/report). I added back the missing `@router.get("/dashboard/report")` decorator (a straightforward missing-decorator coding bug, not business logic) and confirmed the endpoint now returns 200 with the expected report shape. Regression-guarded with a new pytest test (test_dashboard_report_export_endpoint_still_works).

minor.issue: Pre-existing (unrelated to this session's changes) field-name mismatch: the endpoint returns summary as the raw dashboard/stats shape (e.g. summary.revenue.gross, summary.costs.total) but AdminAccountingDashboard.jsx's handleExportCSV reads report.summary.gross_revenue, report.summary.refunds, report.summary.net_revenue, report.summary.total_cost, report.summary.gross_profit, report.summary.profit_margin, report.summary.total_orders, report.summary.items_sold, report.summary.total_customers - none of which exist in the nested shape, so the exported CSV would show '$undefined' for every summary row. Out of scope for this billing feature but worth a follow-up fix since it directly affects the Export CSV button's output quality.

action_items: Optional follow-up (pre-existing, not from this session): fix the field-name mismatch between accounting.py's get_dashboard_report() summary shape and AdminAccountingDashboard.jsx's handleExportCSV field reads, so the CSV export shows real numbers instead of '$undefined'.
No action needed on the billing/invoicing/customer-sync/FareHarbor-masking/accounting-card work itself - all verified working correctly end-to-end.
critical_code_review_comments: tours_charters_billing.py: clean, well-organized module; _compute_totals/_next_invoice_number helpers are correctly reused across create/update; mark-paid logic correctly sets amount_paid=total and amount_due=0 only on unpaid->paid transition (won't double-add if already paid).

activity_marketplace.py _sync_seller_customer(): correctly one-way syncs seller->customer, uses invoice_email falling back to contact_email, lowercases+trims email, and importantly guards against clobbering an unrelated existing user account with the same email (returns None instead of creating a duplicate) - good defensive coding.

admin_settings.py FeatureFlags: fareharbor_api_app/fareharbor_api_user masking follows the exact same pattern as printful client_secret masking (mask-on-GET, skip-overwrite-if-value-starts-with-mask-prefix-on-PUT) - consistent with existing conventions in the file.

FOUND+FIXED: missing @router.get decorator in accounting.py that silently broke GET /dashboard/report (see backend_issues.critical) - this is the kind of regression that's easy to introduce when inserting new endpoints between existing ones without a blank-line/decorator sanity check; worth double-checking adjacent function boundaries whenever inserting a new route in a large router file.

Public invoice view + Stripe Pay Now flow (tours_charters_billing.py public_router) correctly reuses the existing get_stripe_secret_key()/StripeCheckout helper from durango_payments.py rather than duplicating Stripe logic - good DRY practice.

get_dashboard_tours_charters_income() correctly excludes void invoices from total_unpaid via `if i.get('status') != 'void'` - sensible accounting logic (void invoices shouldn't count as outstanding AR).

rca_of_the_issue: Missing-decorator RCA: in accounting.py, the new `@router.get("/dashboard/tours-charters-income")` async function was inserted immediately before the pre-existing `async def get_dashboard_report(...)` function with no blank line or decorator separating them - meaning the file literally read `...}\nasync def get_dashboard_report(` with no `@router.get("/dashboard/report")` line above it. FastAPI never registered this route, so any client (the CSV Export button on /admin/accounting) hitting GET /api/accounting/dashboard/report received a generic 404 'Not Found' with no indication of *why*. Mitigation applied: restored `@router.get("/dashboard/report")` immediately above the function definition; verified via curl (200 OK with correct period/summary/top_products/daily_breakdown shape) and added a permanent pytest regression guard (test_dashboard_report_export_endpoint_still_works) so any future refactor that drops this decorator again will fail CI immediately.
